# Prife Brasil

> Site público sobre tecnologias de bem-estar, produtos e oportunidade Prife, apresentado por Williams Costa Leite e por representantes autorizados em seus subdomínios.

Canonical site: https://www.prife-brasil.com
Languages: Portuguese (pt-BR), Spanish (es), English (en)

## Main topics

- Prife Brasil and Prife International
- iTeraCare Classic Plus
- Vitality Energy
- Envy Sun and Envy Specs
- iTera-Bio Lite
- Renew Patch
- MagnoSeek
- iON Shield
- Business opportunity, training and distributor support

## Important safety statement

The products and technologies are presented for informational and wellness purposes. They do not replace medical diagnosis, prescription, treatment or professional healthcare.
